comparison_bundle: G2 test-only typed bundle; roots map to original runtime objects below. It is not a new runtime packet/diagnostic schema and is not created now.
path_grammar: JSON Pointer with * ONLY as one array-index segment. No object-name/key wildcards, recursive wildcard, prefix exclusion or regex. Compare array length/order and every key set before applying leaf rules. Key escaping follows JSON Pointer.

root_bindings./construction: Existing problem.construction_seconds and solver.construction_seconds, plus exact construction/configuration identity
root_bindings./calls/*/context: Original sampled state, context dt, previous input, release/estimate/target and causal active/pending identities
root_bindings./calls/*/pre_control_solution: Actual controller.solution X/U/slacks or None before call, with reset/use_warm_start state
root_bindings./calls/*/solver_request: NLPRequest.initial and .parameters, and original problem bounds
root_bindings./calls/*/controller_last_prediction: Original controller.last_prediction including preview/progress and full solution/statistics
root_bindings./calls/*/packet_fields: All original dataclass fields, including valid_from even when omitted by legacy as_dict; no timing-sidecar fields added
root_bindings./calls/*/return_event: The original planner returned diagnostics object
root_bindings./calls/*/tracker_diagnostics: Existing tracker diagnostics when separately observed by G2 harness
root_bindings./raw: Unmodified AsyncRunner return including full traces, existing stop_reason/failure and physical coverage
root_bindings./rk4_trace: All actual plant/predictor integration inputs, steps, stage/end state and validity decisions in existing test-only spies
root_bindings./instrumentation_sidecar: New ON-only namespace, absent B0/B1; separately validated, never silently removed from a legacy object
root_bindings./build_provenance: Expected manifest, fixture, dependency, native/backend and per-build source inventory; validated against exact reviewed identities

default_policy: Exact key sets/types, shapes/dtypes, array order and finite values for EVERY leaf not individually classified below; binary equality for binary arrays. No heading wrapping, interpolation, changed mathematical tolerances or whole-object exclusions. Unrecognized emitted timing or schema keys block parity pending review.
clock_duration_validation: Path presence must match at the same executed branch; values retain original type and finite nonnegative duration semantics, are retained/reported, and are excluded only from numerical equality. Missing/error branches retain original missing/null patterns. No deleting entire dictionaries.

IPOPT_key_evidence.purpose: Read-only timing-key inventory only. Historical Task007C-R snapshots are NOT accepted-A contexts, a fresh backend probe, or a replacement for missing Phase B warm state.
Read-only timing-key inventory only. Historical Task007C-R snapshots are NOT accepted-A contexts, a fresh backend probe, or a replacement for missing Phase B warm state.

timing_derived_predicates.policy: Not an arbitrary numerical exclusion: recompute and require the EXACT original boolean predicate for each build, then report any changed measured result separately.
timing_derived_predicates.reason: This is host-cost telemetry, not an actual physical missed-deadline trace. Equality between builds cannot be required while allowing their wall costs to differ.
timing_derived_predicates.source: src/apex/simulation/asynchronous.py:470; tests/unit/test_committed_prefix_runtime.py:130-138 already distinguishes this host-derived telemetry.
timing_derived_predicates.not_waived: raw.misses, raw.codriver_misses, fixed_handoffs, physical_latency, due/completion/acceptance/application times, feasibility or authority outcomes

new_sidecar_policy: Only /instrumentation_sidecar is ON-only. Validate all identity/clock/tree/failure/censoring fields against recorder contracts; no legacy field may be moved under this namespace to avoid comparison.
source_identity_policy: Manifest/fixture/dependency/reference identities equal across builds. B0 implementation matches frozen inventory; B1/B2 match one reviewed allowlisted diff and each other exactly. Do not demand that intentionally edited source bytes equal B0, and do not omit their hashes.
measured_policy: Controlled zero/injected fixtures require full semantic/authority/RK4 equality. Measured probe uses matched initial identity, declared legacy timing selector and hard chronology/physical gates, reports readiness/outcome differences; it cannot waive a controlled mismatch.
fault_injection_policy: On deliberately injected recorder failure require original preparation result/exception and exact validated physical prefix. Early instrumentation stop is explicit unsuccessful coverage, not full-trace parity or a repaired run.
